note: Year = composition/first-popular year; original recording dates for this era are mostly undocumented and Spotify versions are often later reissues or re-recordings. Commercial recording of tân nhạc barely existed in the 1940s (live stage, radio, sheet music); artists given are the classic Saigon interpreters who recorded these songs in the 1950s-60s. Wartime (1945-54) north/south split; revolutionary songs heard in Việt Minh zones are not included for lack of identifiable recordings.
